title: The iPhone's erase words read the shared outcome table (the iPhone half of S57a and S58)
evidence: Decided 2026-11-26 (Brad, docs/decisions-for-brad.md): one sentence set for every erase outcome, in packages/health-core/src/erase-outcome.ts eraseOutcomeWords (US-11 AC13); the web reads it. The iPhone still builds its own: ios/HealthRoadmap/MyData/DataEraser.swift reads answer?.error ?? '' for an erase the engine put back, and EraseText.failed or EraseText.refusal words it (EraseText.swift:79-91). To do with the next engine release: the engine answers the outcome key (record not-saved, and the chat step from chatErased and cloudChatErased), and EraseText says eraseOutcomeWords for it, with the iPhone's website-chat sentence after it when the cloud chat step ran. No Swift change until App Store review closes.
